_comment: ADDITIONAL HA CONTROL-PLANE KEYS USB. Use this to add a 2nd/3rd pki/control-plane node to an EXISTING cluster (HA). It does kubeadm join --control-plane (NOT init), so it joins the same etcd/control plane instead of starting a second cluster. Prereqs from the FIRST control-plane: (1) `kubeadm token create --print-join-command` -> token + ca_cert_hash; (2) `kubeadm init phase upload-certs --upload-certs` -> certificate_key (also persisted on the first CP at /etc/hugmesh/kubeadm-certificate-key). All three go in kubernetes.join below. It also needs the shared cluster PKI (kubernetes/pki) so the joining apiserver/etcd trust the same CA.
_comment_mesh: Same mesh as the first control-plane. endpoint empty -> tailscale login_server defaults to the pki node's LAN IP. cp_dns_name is the STABLE control-plane endpoint this node joins (resolved over the mesh / via the first-boot /etc/hosts bridge).
_comment_kubernetes: role=control-plane + bootstrap=true + first=false => ADDITIONAL control-plane (kubeadm join --control-plane). keys-provision also probes https://<cp_dns_name>:6443/healthz: if the cluster is already up it joins as additional regardless of the flag. join.api_server empty auto-targets cp_dns_name:6443. certificate_key is REQUIRED for a control-plane join.
_comment_nodes: Reach the first pki control-plane + mesh by IP (written to /etc/hosts) so tailscale login_server and the cp_dns_name kubeadm target resolve before MagicDNS converges.
